title: Fix Payment Management FR data update paths and per-company feature status
summary: Centralizes the French payment data migration in a new codeunit so the Feature Management path also remaps payment step object IDs, and adds an upgrade tag to repair companies migrated before remapping existed. Feature status is no longer copied to every company after a data update, in the Payment Management FR app and the three GB apps.
key_points: New codeunit 10844 holds the single migration implementation, so the Feature Management data update also remaps object IDs
Separate upgrade tag for remapping repairs companies that migrated before remapping was added
Removed cross-company ModifyAll from AfterUpdate in the FR and GB feature codeunits that wrongly marked other companies as Complete
Fixed bank account field transfer direction so RIB data moves from base application fields into the app fields
Data update check now counts all migrated tables and no longer writes upgrade tags
